payload.title: Document mandatory GitHub issue gate in open-github-pr skill
payload.body:
## Context

The `open-github-pr` Cursor skill allowed omitting linked GitHub issues when there was “no tracking issue,” so PRs could ship without Development-panel linkage.

## Scope

- Add a **mandatory gate**: resolve or create related issues (`gh issue list` / `gh issue create` with temp `--body-file`) and verify each is **OPEN** via `gh issue view` **before** `gh pr create`.
- Document **cross-repo** tracking (no duplicate issue in this repo when work is tracked elsewhere), **stacked PRs** (every layer still verifies issues; only `Refs` vs `Closes`/`Fixes` varies), and **failure modes** when `gh issue create` fails.
- Renumber the workflow (issue step after push), update the optional worktree section, and extend the quality checklist.

## Acceptance criteria

- Skill instructions consistently forbid opening a PR until referenced issues exist and are verified open (or external-repo flow is explicit).
- `## Related issues` in PRs opened with the skill always include `Closes`/`Fixes`/`Refs` with real issue references.
